nodes.speaker: Mabel
nodes.text: Wages came home in one night. Took Vane a fortnight to steal them and you one train to fix it. I've stopped charging you for opinions — first one's free.

nodes.speaker: Mabel
nodes.text: Shelves are full again, thanks to you. Need anything?

nodes.speaker: Mabel
nodes.text: For the bloodthirsty steed. Tell him the window's been fixed and I hold no grudges I can prove.

nodes.speaker: Mabel
nodes.text: Cold iron — one bite of it and those night prowlers leave your pockets be. Works once, then it's theirs. Repeat customers welcome.

nodes.speaker: Mabel
nodes.text: The opinion is: that horse of yours has learned to open the apple barrel. I have no evidence. I have losses.
